# Slides 9 to 12

```{r}
ChickWeight %>%
  ggplot() #empty ggplot function

ChickWeight %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = weight)) #provide the aesthetic mapping (in this case, x-axis only)

ChickWeight %>%
  ggplot(mapping =  aes(x = weight)) + #provide the aesthetic mapping (in this case, x-axis only)
  geom_histogram() #tell ggplot which geometry to use, in this case a histogram
```



## Slides 15 - 16 (Include the following in your ICMA file)

ICMA question: what's the difference between these two code chunks? Are the outputs the same?
**Answer here**: 


```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(y = hwy, x = displ, color = manufacturer)) + 
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ, color = manufacturer)) + 
  geom_point()
```


## Slide 19 (Include the following in your ICMA file)

ICMA question: what are these warnings about and why should we worry about them?
**Answer**:

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ, shape = manufacturer)) + 
  geom_point()
```

## Slides 24 - 27

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ)) + 
  geom_point(color = "blue")
```

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 8)
```

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 23, 
             color = "red",
             fill = "black")
```

# Slides 30 - 31

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ)) +
  geom_point()
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ)) +
  geom_smooth()
```

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()
```

# Slide 36

```{r}
# left
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ, group = drv)) +
  geom_smooth()
# right
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ, color = drv)) +
  geom_smooth()
```


# Slide 42 (Include in ICMA)

Change the color of the line to something other than the default blue

```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = class)) + 
  geom_polygon(color='red')
```
